title: Stockx Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stockx:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in stockx metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme stockx metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out the unusually high or low value moments in your stockx metric0 history.
